description.value:
Hit Die: 1d6

Class skills (automated): +1 to Persuade and Intimidate when this Class is added to a character; removed again if the Class is removed.

Class feature: Orders: once per round, as a Bonus Action, an ally who can hear you may move 10 ft or make a Defense with +1.
